1.1|Gross Margin %|MEASURE|=IFERROR(([@TOTAL_REVENUE]-[@TOTAL_COGS])/[@TOTAL_REVENUE],"")
1.2|AI Cost Ratio|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@INFERENCE_COST]/[@TOTAL_REVENUE],"")
1.3|Total COGS %|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@TOTAL_COGS]/[@TOTAL_REVENUE],"")
1.4|Blended Cost per 1M Tokens|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@INFERENCE_COST]/[@AI_TOKENS_TOTAL_M],"")
1.5|Contribution Margin $|MEASURE|=[@GROSS_PROFIT]-[@SUPPORT_COST]-[@DATA_PIPELINE_COST]
1.6|Contribution Margin %|MEASURE|=IFERROR(([@GROSS_PROFIT]-[@SUPPORT_COST]-[@DATA_PIPELINE_COST])/[@TOTAL_REVENUE],"")
1.7|Margin vs Plan (points)|MEASURE|=IFERROR((([@TOTAL_REVENUE]-[@TOTAL_COGS])/[@TOTAL_REVENUE]-([@PLAN_TOTAL_REVENUE]-[@PLAN_TOTAL_COGS])/[@PLAN_TOTAL_REVENUE])*100,"")
1.8|Account Health Category|ATTRIBUTE|=IF([@GROSS_PROFIT]<0,"Loss-making",IF(IFERROR([@GROSS_PROFIT]/[@TOTAL_REVENUE],0)<0.5,"Below Floor","Healthy"))
2.1|YoY Revenue Growth %|MEASURE|=IFERROR(([@TOTAL_REVENUE]-[@PY_TOTAL_REVENUE])/[@PY_TOTAL_REVENUE],"")
2.2|Revenue per Active Seat|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@TOTAL_REVENUE]/[@SEATS_ACTIVE],"")
2.3|Revenue per MAU|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@TOTAL_REVENUE]/[@MAU],"")
2.4|Subscription Revenue Mix %|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@SUBSCRIPTION_REVENUE]/([@SUBSCRIPTION_REVENUE]+[@USAGE_REVENUE]),"")
2.5|Overage Revenue|MEASURE|=MAX(0,[@USAGE_REVENUE]-[@INCLUDED_AI_CREDITS_USD])
2.6|Plan vs Actual Revenue Delta|MEASURE|=[@TOTAL_REVENUE]-[@PLAN_TOTAL_REVENUE]
2.7|Revenue per AI Token|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@TOTAL_REVENUE]/([@AI_TOKENS_TOTAL_M]*1000000),"")
2.8|ARR Estimate|MEASURE|=[@TOTAL_REVENUE]*12
2.9|NRR Proxy|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@TOTAL_REVENUE]/[@PY_TOTAL_REVENUE],"")
2.10|Inference Share of COGS %|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@INFERENCE_COST]/[@TOTAL_COGS],"")
2.11|Infra Cost per Seat|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@INFRA_COST]/[@SEATS_ACTIVE],"")
2.12|Support Cost per MAU|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@SUPPORT_COST]/[@MAU],"")
2.13|Payment Fee %|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@PAYMENT_FEES]/[@TOTAL_REVENUE],"")
2.14|COGS ex-Inference|MEASURE|=[@INFRA_COST]+[@DATA_PIPELINE_COST]+[@SUPPORT_COST]
2.15|Cost per Token (All-in)|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@TOTAL_COGS]/([@AI_TOKENS_TOTAL_M]*1000000),"")
2.16|YoY COGS Change %|MEASURE|=IFERROR(([@TOTAL_COGS]-[@PY_TOTAL_COGS])/[@PY_TOTAL_COGS],"")
2.17|Plan vs Actual COGS Delta|MEASURE|=[@TOTAL_COGS]-[@PLAN_TOTAL_COGS]
2.18|COGS per Active Seat|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@TOTAL_COGS]/[@SEATS_ACTIVE],"")
2.19|Input/Output Token Ratio|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@AI_TOKENS_INPUT_M]/[@AI_TOKENS_OUTPUT_M],"")
2.20|Revenue per 1M Tokens|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@TOTAL_REVENUE]/[@AI_TOKENS_TOTAL_M],"")
2.21|Inference Cost per MAU|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@INFERENCE_COST]/[@MAU],"")
2.22|Tokens (M) per Active Seat|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@AI_TOKENS_TOTAL_M]/[@SEATS_ACTIVE],"")
2.23|Output Token Share %|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@AI_TOKENS_OUTPUT_M]/[@AI_TOKENS_TOTAL_M],"")
2.24|AI Credit Utilization %|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@INFERENCE_COST]/[@INCLUDED_AI_CREDITS_USD],"")
2.25|Tokens (M) per MAU|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@AI_TOKENS_TOTAL_M]/[@MAU],"")
2.26|Seat Utilization %|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@SEATS_ACTIVE]/[@SEATS_LICENSED],"")
2.27|Seats Unlicensed (Unused)|MEASURE|=[@SEATS_LICENSED]-[@SEATS_ACTIVE]
2.28|Revenue per Licensed Seat|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@TOTAL_REVENUE]/[@SEATS_LICENSED],"")
2.29|Health Score Band|ATTRIBUTE|=IF([@HEALTH_SCORE]<50,"At Risk",IF([@HEALTH_SCORE]<75,"Neutral","Healthy"))
2.30|Strategic Logo Label|ATTRIBUTE|=IF([@IS_STRATEGIC_LOGO]=1,"Strategic","Standard")
2.31|Seat Expansion vs Base %|MEASURE|=IFERROR(([@SEATS_LICENSED]-[@SEATS_LICENSED_BASE])/[@SEATS_LICENSED_BASE],"")
2.32|Contract Term Label|ATTRIBUTE|=[@CONTRACT_TERM_MONTHS]&" months"
2.33|Account Status|ATTRIBUTE|=IF([@IS_ACTIVE]=0,"Churned","Active")
2.34|Account Tier (ACV)|ATTRIBUTE|=IF(OR(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("150K",[@ACV_BAND])),ISNUMBER(SEARCH("500K+",[@ACV_BAND]))),"Enterprise","Commercial")
2.35|Power Tier Loss Flag|ATTRIBUTE|=IF(AND([@AI_ADOPTION_TIER]="Power",[@GROSS_PROFIT]<0),"At Risk","OK")
2.36|Quarter-End Label|ATTRIBUTE|=IF([@IS_QUARTER_END]=1,"QE","")
2.37|Pricing Model Category|ATTRIBUTE|=IF(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("usage",[@PRICING_MODEL])),"Usage-based","Other")
2.38|EMEA Flag|MEASURE|=IF([@REGION]="EMEA",1,0)
2.39|Billing Frequency (Normalized)|ATTRIBUTE|=IF(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("month",[@BILLING_FREQUENCY])),"Monthly",IF(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("quarter",[@BILLING_FREQUENCY])),"Quarterly",IF(OR(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("ann",[@BILLING_FREQUENCY])),ISNUMBER(SEARCH("year",[@BILLING_FREQUENCY]))),"Annual","Other")))
2.40|Currency Group|ATTRIBUTE|=IF([@CURRENCY]<>"USD","Non-USD","USD")
2.41|Revenue Attainment %|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@TOTAL_REVENUE]/[@PLAN_TOTAL_REVENUE],"")
2.42|COGS Attainment %|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@TOTAL_COGS]/[@PLAN_TOTAL_COGS],"")
2.43|Inference Cost vs Plan Delta|MEASURE|=[@INFERENCE_COST]-[@PLAN_INFERENCE_COST]
2.44|Inference Cost Attainment %|MEASURE|=IFERROR([@INFERENCE_COST]/[@PLAN_INFERENCE_COST],"")
2.45|COGS vs Plan Status|ATTRIBUTE|=IF(IFERROR([@TOTAL_COGS]/[@PLAN_TOTAL_COGS],0)>1.05,"Over","On Track")
2.46|Gross Profit vs Plan Delta|MEASURE|=([@TOTAL_REVENUE]-[@TOTAL_COGS])-([@PLAN_TOTAL_REVENUE]-[@PLAN_TOTAL_COGS])
2.47|Month Label with Year|ATTRIBUTE|=[@MONTH_NAME]&" "&[@YEAR]
2.48|Is H2|MEASURE|=IF([@HALF]="H2",1,0)
2.49|Is Current Quarter|MEASURE|=IF([@QUARTER_LABEL]="Q"&ROUNDUP(MONTH(TODAY())/3,0)&" "&YEAR(TODAY()),1,0)
2.50|Days in Month|ATTRIBUTE|=DAY([@MONTH_END_DATE])
2.51|Fiscal Year Label|ATTRIBUTE|="FY"&[@FISCAL_YEAR]
2.52|Year-End Label|ATTRIBUTE|=IF([@IS_YEAR_END]=1,"YE","")
